title: Complete water-clock account with nested part identities and a closed seasonal state
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED. Vitruvius IX.8.8–15 describes one connected clock whose repeated parts, date setting, flow and hour length constrain each other through an annual return. A fixed-duration or reversed-flow rival preserves names but changes the stated effects.

source_evidence.quote: ## B. VitruviusIX.8.8–15: derselbe Apparat, anderer Datumszustand

source.work: Vitruvius De architectura IX.8.8–15, complete anaphoric-clock description through book transition
source.historical_date: Ancient work, late first century BCE; owned text is the later public-domain Gwilt English translation hosted by LacusCurtius, not a medieval witness. Exact printed edition/year and Latin variants were not collated in this bounded pass.
source.boundary: 8. Other kinds of winter-dials... through15 ...will complete this Treatise on Architecture.
source.edition_limit: Anaporica spelling, eighth-division references and the hydraulic explanations remain this translation branch. Physical engineering adequacy is not certified. The prior analemma construction is an explicit prerequisite outside this bounded clock description.

design.historical_writing_mechanism: Relative references distinguish a fixed larger tympanum, movable lesser tympanum, tongue, float/counterweight and display wheel. Tympanum occurs in more than one technical role; equal noun spelling does not make all devices the same physical component. Daily holes/marks index a known global date state.
whole_content_model: Analemma-based hour rods and month circles frame the zodiac display wheel.
An axle and chain couple a water-raised float to an equal sand counterweight; opposed movement turns the wheel.
A sun index is moved among month/day holes; changing zodiac arcs yields seasonal hour differences.
A piped cistern supplies nested fitting regulator drums, one fixed and one rotatable, with365outerpoints and a tongue attached to the inner body.
Cancer is upper, Capricorn lower, Aries and Libra lateral. Daily changes in tongue/hole position alter the stated pressure/flow and fill time.
The winter setting flows faster and makes shorter hours; the summer setting slower and longer. Aries and Libra give equinoctial hours; descent returns through Scorpio/Sagittarius to Capricorn.
The author closes this account and announces the following machine book.
design.coupled_consequence: The same named part persists through date-state changes, while the state changes its effect. An annual return of the regulator configuration must restore the corresponding winter consequence; the two equinoctial states agree in hour class without being the same angular location. Float rise entails counterweight descent and wheel motion under the written coupling.

precise_rivals.rule: Each date simply names a different independent apparatus.
precise_rivals.different_consequence: Drops the source-held nested part identities and the return to the same regulator setting.

precise_rivals.rule: Greater inflow lengthens the time to fill the same receiving vessel.
precise_rivals.different_consequence: Reverses the explicitly stated winter/summer hour consequence.

precise_rivals.rule: A list of12signs or365marks exhausts the passage.
precise_rivals.different_consequence: Cannot represent opposed chain motion, nested regulator identity, both equinox effects and annual return.

finite_semantic_restrictions: Separate display wheel, float, cistern, fixed regulator and movable regulator even when a common technical noun is reused.
Date advances along one shared annual state; no independently chosen sign-to-effect value per occurrence.
Maintain source-prescribed opposite movement and inverse flow/fill-time relation.

Exact dimensions, flow equations and all daily durations are not supplied, so no fully numerical simulation or exact365-state writer is licensed.
The prior analemma is an external construction call. No Voynich drawing or paragraph is selected; a generic pipe likeness or circular layout would be insufficient.
